title: crypto-docs
text:
This site is a growing collection of personal notes on cryptography: definitions, protocols, and the math behind them.
Use the search box in the navbar to find topics across all notes. Add new material under topics/ as folders and .qmd files; the sidebar updates automatically from the filesystem.

title: crypto-docs
text:
Notation
Unless a page says otherwise, we use standard conventions: \(\mathbb{Z}_p\) for integers mod \(p\), \(|x|\) for bit length, and \(\oplus\) for XOR.
See About for scope and disclaimers.

title: About
text: These pages are reference notes, not a textbook or a substitute for primary sources (standards, papers, and audited implementations). They may be incomplete or contain errors—verify anything security-critical elsewhere.

title: About
text:
Building locally
Install Quarto, then from the repository root:
quarto preview   # live preview with search (http://localhost)
quarto render    # build static site to _site/
Search does not work when opening HTML files directly from disk (file://); use quarto preview or the deployed GitHub Pages URL.

title: About
text:
Publishing
Pushes to main trigger the GitHub Action that renders and publishes to the gh-pages branch. After the first successful deploy, the site is available at:
https://tfullert.github.io/crypto-docs/
(Once the GitHub repository exists and Pages is enabled from gh-pages.)

title: Topics
text:
Notes are organized in subfolders under topics/. Each folder can include an index.qmd (section intro) and one or more topic pages.
Add a new directory here when you start a subject; it will appear automatically in the sidebar.
